name: one_at_a_time
one_line: One unit of work per call, in an order code decides.
pros: The order costs nothing to communicate, because it is never sent.
A failure loses one unit of work.
cons: Call count equals the horizon. This is the dominant cost at scale.
The order is fixed, so it cannot react to what a unit contained.
Per-call overhead is paid the maximum number of times.
pick_this_when: Per-call cost is low and prompt size is the constraint.
Units are independent and order does not matter.
avoid_when: Calls are the expensive thing. Batch instead.
